market.question: Will the highest temperature in Sao Paulo be 26°C on April 30?

assessment.reasoning: Forecast for Sao Paulo (Guarulhos) Apr 30 shows high near 27°C (~81°F) with thunderstorms possible. The 26°C bucket is one degree below the forecast central tendency, so it is a plausible but not most-likely outcome.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Cloud cover/storms could shave a degree off, putting the high right in this bucket.
